about: Rules shared by the Rust commands (src-tauri/src/sync.rs) and the browser mock (src/lib/ipc/mock-sync.test.ts). See ADR 0009. Each case renames this device with `input`: it is refused (`error` is the code and message) or saved as `saved`. `unique_name_cases` give a device's wanted name and the names already taken in the group, and the name it is stored under; `code_cases` say what a typed pairing code reads as (null: not a code). `address_cases` give a typed Address and what is stored (`stored`, `port`) or why it is refused (`error`).

name_cases.name: forty accented characters are fine (characters, not bytes)

error.message: A device name is at most 40 characters

unique_name_cases.name: the next free number is used
